single.rationale: Surgery Partners demonstrates solid operational momentum with 4.9% same-facility revenue growth and improving free cash flow generation ($195.6M in FY2025), but carries significant leverage ($3.7B debt vs $1.7B equity) and persistent net losses despite positive operating income. The favorable industry tailwinds (aging population, migration to lower-cost ASC settings from a $150B addressable market) and 6% expected ASC procedure growth offer upside, but execution risks around integration, payor negotiations, and debt service warrant monitoring before deeper commitment.
